name: Exploding Piece Carousel
description: Image carousel that slices the picture into horizontal strips which rotate and fly off screen on navigation, then the next image's strips fly back in and reassemble.
behavior: Clicking an arrow rotates the strips, then flies them out in alternating directions
New image strips enter from opposite sides and settle with a rotation
Navigation loops at both ends and is blocked while animating
Image scales down on narrow screens, arrows shrink
editableByProps: Image size, number of strips, fly distance, rotation and timing

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the easing or the order of the rotate and fly steps

needsCodeEdit.where: arrowClass constant and the arrow spans

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
